name: Whispers of the Ancients
body:
Prerequisite(s): Nganga level 7th, Ancestral Guidance class feature

Benefit(s): When you use your Ancestral Guidance ability, you can choose to gain information about a specific topic instead of receiving an augury effect.

This functions as the spell commune, but you can only ask one question per use of Ancestral Guidance. The spirits answer to the best of their ability, but their knowledge is limited to what they knew in life plus what they have observed since death.

Special: You can use this ability to ask an additional question when using Ancestral Guidance at 14th level.
